description: Controlled two-commit fixture for source-range mapping, rename identity, impact paths, and tiered test selection.
required_invariants: all changed symbol evidence carries the exact base or target snapshot ID
changed method impact includes its override without relabeling the relation as a call
ambiguous dispatch paths remain conservative and carry uncertainty
runtime evidence from another snapshot is excluded
without runtime baseline, Tier A and Tier B are unavailable
Tier C ordering is stable by pytest node ID
Tier C evidence binds to the isolated collection run and runtime environment
